lead_memo.title: Chancellor McCormick Freezes $8.4B Apex Acquisition of CyberLogic, Establishing Novel Antitrust Monopsony Doctrine
lead_memo.bluf: The Delaware Chancery Court granted an emergency preliminary injunction blocking Apex Capital’s acquisition of CyberLogic. Ruling that consolidated compute contracts constitute an anti-competitive restraint under Clayton Act Section 7, the court froze closing procedures, instantly collapsing merger arbitrage spreads by 1,420 basis points across institutional arbitrage desks.
lead_memo.why_it_matters: Institutional desks holding multi-million spread exposures are recalibrating downside scenarios. The memorandum indicates that pre-scheduled break fees of $420M may become non-enforceable should the Clayton Act Section 7 claim prevail at the scheduled December 4 evidentiary hearing.
lead_memo.between_the_lines: Corporate legal officers at major Silicon Valley entities confirmed to BrieflyQ that four private equity syndicates have placed immediate holds on contract execution. The ruling directly impacts transactions involving exclusive sovereign cloud allocations.

primary_sources.filing_type: Memorandum Opinion & Order Granting Motion for Preliminary Injunction
primary_sources.governing_statute: Clayton Antitrust Act 15 U.S.C. § 18; Delaware General Corporation Law 8 Del. C. § 251

institutional_analyses.title: Direct Lenders Force Super-Senior Recapitalization on $650M Enterprise SaaS Facilities
institutional_analyses.bluf: Apollo and Ares completed a priority restructuring for CloudMetrics, subordinating mezzanine creditors following covenant breach. Coupon resets to SOFR + 750 bps with equity warrant dilution reaching 22% of total capitalization.
institutional_analyses.context: The maneuver marks a sharp resurgence in aggressive liability management exercises (LMEs) across private debt portfolios facing multiple compression.

primary_sources.agent: Apollo Global Management Credit Strategies / Ares Private Credit

institutional_analyses.title: Second Circuit Reinstates Shareholder Action Over Premature AI GPU Revenue Bookings
institutional_analyses.bluf: Overturning a lower dismissal, the 2nd U.S. Circuit Court ruled that premature recognition of cloud cluster pre-orders satisfies Section 10(b) scienter standards when top executives executed concurrent $45M in 10b5-1 executive stock dispositions.
institutional_analyses.context: Circuit Judge Raymond Lohier ruled that customary forward-looking disclaimers fail to insulate corporate defendants when internal forecasts contradict GAAP.

institutional_analyses.title: FTC Scrutinizes Frontier AI Hyperscaler Joint Ventures as De Facto Unreported Mergers
institutional_analyses.bluf: The FTC issued formal 6(b) compulsory orders examining whether exclusive compute allocation agreements evade Hart-Scott-Rodino notification requirements. Regulators warned of daily civil penalties exceeding $50,120 per violation for structural circumvention.
institutional_analyses.context: The inquiry scrutinizes multi-tier commercial observer rights that grant corporate giants operational oversight without official board votes.

primary_sources.order_authority: FTC Act Section 6(b) [15 U.S.C. § 46(b)] Compulsory Study
